omittedFootprintPolicy: Omitted @Modifies means unknown writes, including globals, on normal and exceptional exits. It never means an empty footprint. Unspecified reference inputs may escape; results may alias. An empty footprint grants neither freshness nor stable observations under concurrent interference.
